name: Workshop Industrial
signature: Charcoal slab, safety-orange blocks, hazard-stripe dividers, condensed caps.

contrast.note: Dark theme. Orange is safe as text on both backgrounds. Buttons are orange with charcoal labels.

motion.rule: Snap in: each block rises 28px and fades in over 500ms, no bounce, and numbers count up only when they are real.

hero.layout: Full-width photo of the real shop or owner at work, tinted charcoal-to-orange (photo under an accent layer with mix-blend-mode: multiply). Headline bottom-left, call button and estimate button under it, 12px hazard-stripe divider below the hero.
hero.photo: Real shop photo required; no stock mechanics.

background: Solid charcoal. A 1px blueprint grid at 4% ink opacity behind the hero only. Hazard stripes (45deg, accent and bg, 12px tall) appear once, as the divider under the hero.

button.fill: Accent fill, onAccent label, 2px accent border.
button.label: Uppercase, weight 700, 0.06em tracking.
button.hover: Press feedback with data-press; colors swap instantly, nothing glows.
